**Command**, from the repository root at the commit above:

```sh
./gradlew :rig:run --args="--brain random_nodescend --against random --seeds standard --cap 20000 --out <dir> --registration H-0004-nodescend-worse"
```

Salts are drawn when each Run executes (ADR-0007), so the command reproduces the distribution, not these Runs; a Run itself is replayed from its log with `--replay`, and its salt and chain are in the committed index.

## The test

**REJECT** after 20 pairs. GSPRT, H0: p0 = 0.500, H1: p1 = 0.600, burn-in 20, maximum 500, missing cap 250 per mil. Bounds -2.944 and 2.944, in natural log units (a log-likelihood ratio). Consumed pairs worse / equal / better: 0 / 20 / 0; missing pairs over all 500: 42.

A pair with a Run the game did not end scores ½ and is counted among the equal ones; the result is void if more of the consumed pairs are missing than the cap allows.

**Every consumed pair tied.** A one-sided test rejects two Brains that played alike as readily as a worse one, so a REJECT here says only that; it is no evidence of "worse".

Reported statistic -2.944, clamped at the bound. The trace, one value per consumed pair; the first 20 are the burn-in, which cannot stop the test, and their size at the start is the regularization dividing by almost no variance:

```
-10.040  -40.080  -90.120  -160.160  -250.200  -360.240  -490.280  -640.320  -810.360  -1000.400
-1210.440  -1440.480  -1690.520  -1960.560  -2250.600  -2560.640  -2890.680  -3240.720  -3610.760  -4000.800
```

**Pair correlation**: turns survived, over the 458 pairs both Runs of which ended: r = 1.000; pairs that ended alike in every part of the Composite outcome: 458.
